import httpx
from sqlalchemy import Engine, text

from insights_platform.data import get_connection
from insights_platform.web import create_app

app = create_app()


def headcount() -> int:
    engine = get_connection("warehouse")
    assert isinstance(engine, Engine)
    with engine.connect() as conn:
        return int(conn.execute(text("select count(*) from headcount")).scalar_one())


def hr_client() -> httpx.Client:
    client = get_connection("hr-api")
    if not isinstance(client, httpx.Client):
        raise httpx.HTTPError("hr-api is not an HTTP connection")
    return client
